subject: website
name: git-swarm viewer
summary: A serverless git viewer on Swarm that downloads a repository pack through the bzz.limo gateway and renders it in the page. Its single script is a minified bundle with no source map, and no public repository of it was found, so it stays at Level 2. Even with a source it would stop at 3, because it relies on a gateway to fetch the pack.

connections.name: Swarm gateway (bzz.limo)
connections.note: Fetches the repository pack when the page opens.
